fields.Name: IT89 - Role Privilege Elevation Guard
fields.Description: Issue #4282 on the real stack: ClassFactory resolves MJUserRoleEntityServer for MJ: User Roles and MJRoleEntityServer for MJ: Roles, and the provider builds both (RE1); a non-Owner assigning a role they do not hold is refused by the guard's Validate() with the error attributed to RoleID (RE2); a non-Owner assigning a role they DO hold still validates, so delegated administration is not closed (RE3); an Owner may assign any role, so the admin path stays open (RE4); creating a MJ: Roles row is refused for a non-Owner and permitted for an Owner (RE5); and — where a non-Owner principal actually holds CanCreate on MJ: User Roles — a real Save() of a self-grant does not succeed, attempted inside an always-rolled-back transaction (RE6). The guards' branch logic is unit-covered in MJCoreEntitiesServer; this bundle proves the wiring. Server transport; no fixtures created and nothing persisted.
